derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040nr.pdf (IRS fillable form, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1040nr.pdf, 177,160 bytes), not from field-name numbering: every entry's widget /Rect (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row. The TY2025 1040-NR prints AGI as 11a (page 1) repeated as 11b (page 2). Deliberately NOT mapped (stay blank, each covered by a packet manifest note): the fiscal-year and 301.9100-2/combat-zone/deceased header fields (f1_01-f1_13; a calendar-year student filer leaves them blank), the QSS child-name field (f1_25), the Digital Assets Yes/No boxes (c1_6 — not a stored fact), the page-1 Dependents table (the NR engine states no dependent credits in v1 and flags stored dependents instead), lines 1b-1j and 2-7 (income types the NR engine does not state; 1i/1j are printed 'Reserved for future use'), line 10 (no adjustments stated), lines 13a-13c/17/19-21/23a-23d/25b/25c/25e/25f/26/28-31/35a/36/38 (zero or out of scope in v1), the foreign-address block (f1_22/f1_23/f1_24 — the stored identity carries one U.S. mailing address and no foreign address), the direct-deposit and foreign-refund-address fields (bank details are not stored), the third-party designee and paid-preparer blocks, and the signature/date fields (the signer signs). The form's page 2 carries NO visa/citizenship questions in TY2025 — those live on Schedule OI (Form 1040-NR), which has its own map.
